notes: V30.32 removes AlvaAR from the photographic registration path completely. Survey photos are captured even with no valid Alva pose, their own corners are detected from frozen RGB/gray, pairwise overlaps are verified by photo-only BRIEF/ZNCC + homography RANSAC, and a global 2-D mosaic with loop refinement plus local parallax warp is solved solely from image correspondences. Alva pose/covariance, when available, is optional metadata for the unchanged metric/3-D path and cannot admit, reject, place, rotate or warp a photo. Raw Depth Anything remains a second layer aligned statistically through the same RGB overlaps. The 3-D reconstruction algorithms remain unchanged.
